title.rendered: Christ in You, the Hope of Glory: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: Christ in you, the hope of glory. The mystery hidden for ages, now disclosed. Christ Himself, by His Spirit, inside the believer. This is the deepest truth about the mind of Christ.

content.rendered:
Christ in you, the hope of glory. The mystery hidden for ages and generations. Now disclosed. Christ Himself, by His Spirit, inside the believer. This is the deepest truth about the mind of Christ. He is not a concept to be thought about. He is a Person living inside you.

The Gospel For Today | Sunday, June 28, 2026

Today’s Scripture

“To them God has chosen to make known among the Gentiles the glorious riches of this mystery, which is Christ in you, the hope of glory.”
Colossians 1:27 (NIV)

Today’s Message

Paul calls it a mystery. The Greek is mysterion, which in New Testament usage does not mean a puzzle the human mind cannot solve. It means a truth that was hidden for ages, then revealed by God at the right time, that can only be known by revelation. The mystery Paul names in Colossians 1:27 is the deepest of them all. Christ in you, the hope of glory.

To the Old Testament saints, this was unthinkable. The presence of God dwelt in a tabernacle, then a temple. The Spirit came on prophets, priests and kings for specific tasks. But the God of Israel actually living inside the heart of an ordinary believer? That was a mystery the prophets could only glimpse from a distance. Jeremiah hinted at it. Ezekiel prophesied it. Joel saw it coming. Then on Pentecost morning, the curtain came down and the mystery walked out into the open. The Spirit poured out on all flesh. Christ Himself, by His Spirit, taking up residence in the hearts of those who believed.

This is the perfect verse to close a series on the mind of Christ. The mind of Christ is not just a way of thinking. It is the result of having Christ Himself inside us. The renewing of the mind is the working out of the inner reality of Christ in us. The peace that guards the mind is the personal presence of the Prince of Peace. The wisdom from above is the Person of the Wisdom of God Himself, dwelling in the heart of the believer.

And Paul calls this Christ in you the hope of glory. The hope of glory is the assurance that the work begun in you will be brought to completion. The glory you have not yet seen, the glory of the resurrection, the glory of the new heavens and the new earth, the glory of being conformed fully to the image of Christ, is guaranteed by the presence of Christ already inside you. The down payment of glory is in. The full inheritance is coming.

For Sunday, this is the truth worth carrying into worship. The same Lord you are singing to is the Lord who already lives in you. The same Spirit you are praying to is the Spirit praying through you. Worship is not reaching for a distant God. Worship is the inner reality of God in you breaking out into expression. That is the mind of Christ. Not a philosophy. A Person. Living in you. Today. Until glory.

Prayer

Father, thank You for the mystery now made known to me. Christ in me, the hope of glory. Your Son lives in me by Your Spirit. The mind of Christ is mine because the Person of Christ is in me. Today I worship from that inner reality. I am not reaching for You. You are already inside me. Let everything I do today flow from the truth of Christ in me. In Jesus’ name. Amen.

Declaration

Christ is in me, the hope of glory. The mystery hidden for ages is now my daily reality. The Son of God lives in me by His Spirit. My mind is His. My heart is His. My future is His. Until glory comes in full, He is already in me in full.
